_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Rigs (spec section 7): three slots on Lumi, one module per slot, swapped at the bench at no cost. slot_unlock: the id that opens each slot (granted by a district's source). modules: slot; mods = stat multipliers while fitted (hand_rate, kind_<kind>, capacity, handle = handling time, bale_value, value = all payouts, parts_yield, tend, water_hexes); adds = stat additions (carry_stack); source = 'grant' (a district source hands it over, districts.json grants), 'find:<district id>' (found when that district first reaches stage 1) or 'build' (bought at the bench for cost once `district` is open). The Hover Skirt has no numbers of its own: slick work needs it (pollution.json needs_module). The simulator checks that no module is the best fit in every district.
